texts: In the 2020 reboot of "Lost in Space," the role of the robot was played by renowned actor and motion capture artist Andy Serkis. Utilizing his extensive experience in bringing CGI characters to life, Serkis delivered a complex and layered performance that added depth and emotion to the beloved character. His portrayal of the robot, combined with state-of-the-art visual effects, fascinated audiences worldwide and became a highlight of the series.
The robot in the 2018-2021 Netflix series "Lost in Space" (not 2020 specifically) is played by actor Brian Steele, but the voice of the robot is provided by Bill Mumy.

The robot in the 2020 reboot of "Lost in Space" is portrayed by a CGI (Computer-Generated Imagery) character, and it doesn't have a human actor behind the scenes. The robot's design and voice are different from the original series, which aired in the 1960s. In the 2020 version, the robot is named SMART (Sentient, Mobile, Androgynous Robot Transport).
The robot character from Lost in Space 2020 is played by actor Daniel Craig. He was cast as the main antagonist, the android Dr. Jyn Erso.
